verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims SCIM and directory sync as enterprise features, and a community commenter confirms SAML/SCIM exist but notes some are enterprise-only. The pack has no SCIM plugin documentation and nothing showing that IdP deprovisioning revokes app access. missing for 10: SCIM endpoint/plugin documentation, group sync details, documented deprovisioning-to-session/access revocation behavior, hands-on corroboration, clarity on enterprise-only gating.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access

citations.quote: SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync.
and SAML/SCIM. Some of those features are enterprise-only.
